scope: Unchanged startup-anchor replay through its first zero; twelve-row gradients and smaller fractions are diagnostic only
metric_arithmetic: Canonical FP32 subtraction/vector-norm RMS squared in FP64; independent FP64 subtraction/mean-square on exactly the same native prediction

initialization.scope: Repeated six-calibration-source startup constraints; ordinary data stream remains separate; development excluded
initialization.rms_reduction: Sample-pooled squares of original evaluator FP32 window RMS values
initialization.accepted_zero_policy: Advance ordinary Adam moments/counters once even when accepted parameter displacement is zero

solver.rank_policy: FP64 eigensystem at256*eps*max(1,spectral_radius); original equations and every inequality verified; no jitter

first_zero_diagnosis.interpretation: A same-state direction comparison, not a training or convergence result. All six calibration windows are checked at every fraction; development is observation only. Linearization remainders contain nonlinear response and arithmetic.
